title: VASP Mn3Ir: bands of a noncollinear antiferromagnet
summary: Cubic Mn3Ir with the 120° noncollinear antiferromagnetic order and spin-orbit coupling, from VASP: the PAO Hamiltonian (Ir 5P 5D 6S 6P 7S, Mn 3P 3D 4S 4P 4D) and its band structure. Needs your own VASP runs and POTCAR.

steps.label: Mn3Ir noncollinear bands
steps.note: needs the VASP runs of nscf/ (vasprun.xml, WAVECAR, POTCAR); writes output/ and Mn3Ir_VASP.png
